how: Independently re-derived storage authentication in j323 from the two recovered constant copies, the validated serialized seed, and restored storage.seco. I used a separate pure-Python secp256k1 point-add/scalar-multiply/compressed-pubkey and BIP32 CKDpriv implementation rather than j321's cryptography EC implementation, followed only the source-defined path, checked exact SECO length/checksum, reproduced both AES-GCM authentications, and constant-time compared the result to j321. The 2,229-byte plaintexts are identical. I did not infer contact identity from authentication alone.
